title: VGATE Verification Gate Spec
description: A declarative verification-gate contract. The oracle is the external mechanical gate that turns 'assume a claim' into 'verified' (or explicitly not). gate() evaluates the oracle result deterministically: sound x pass = confirmed, statistical x pass = evidence, any x fail = rejected, none = unverified (engine must not run).

provenance.description: Optional audit provenance: where this candidate/spec came from.

claim.description: The single, fully-quantified claim this gate verifies.

soundness.description: Does passing establish the claim? sound = yes within its stated scope (real effect, mechanical check). statistical = evidence only (prediction, backtest). none = no mechanical oracle (engine must NOT run, verdict unverified).

ceiling.description: WHAT PASSING THIS CHECK DOES NOT ESTABLISH. REQUIRED when soundness is statistical or none, because 'best available' must never be read as 'good enough'.

base.description: Base URL for http_chain/http_simple oracles (loopback default 127.0.0.1).

gated.description: If true, require explicit approval before running the oracle.

oracle.description: The external mechanical check, expressed per family.

steps.description: http_chain: stateful ordered steps with variable binding. Each step may carry 'request', 'expect', 'save', 'cond' (conditional).

request.description: http_simple: single request spec {method, path, body, expect}.

parse.description: compute/file_assert: how to parse the command output (regex or key).

markers.description: http_chain: named partial-confirmation booleans for multi-step chains.

assert.description: Predicate over parsed result (e.g. 'axioms subset allowed').

threshold.description: compute: numeric threshold for parsed value.
